# Irawan Agung Nugroho

> Official portfolio and professional profile of Irawan Agung Nugroho — Senior Engineer and FullStack Developer from Magelang, Indonesia, with 15+ years of experience in cloud-native application development.

Irawan Agung Nugroho is a software engineer specializing in Go (Golang), PHP, Laravel, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Docker, AWS, Kubernetes, and PostgreSQL. He builds web applications, mobile apps, enterprise systems, and cloud infrastructure for government, enterprise, and startup clients.
